description: Road Network Data: Bridge seismic design method based on seismic importance adjustment factor and uniform traffic loss risk is a data set deposited in Mendeley Data by its authors Qiang Lian. This is the supplemental data to the paper “Bridge seismic design method based on seismic importance adjustment factor and uniform traffic loss risk”, which contains: 1. Road network traffic volume matrix. 2. Line data (including line length, traffic capacity, and free-flow speed). 3. Existing bridge structural type. Coverage: a single site or case study; the metadata date the deposit to 2024. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-mendeley-repository.
